fields.label: Country Code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. SA, AE, BH, OM, QA, KW, IN

fields.label: Minimum Wage
fields.description: Lowest allowed Base salary for this country. Leave 0 to disable the check.

fields.label: Statutory Scheme
fields.options:
GOSI
GPSSA
SIO
PASI
GRSIA
PIFSS
EPF+ESI
DEWS
None

fields.label: Contribution Basis
fields.options:
Basic Salary
Basic + Housing
Total Salary

fields.label: Contribution Ceiling
fields.description: Leave 0 for no ceiling

fields.label: Settlement Formula
fields.options:
EOSB-SA
Gratuity-AE
Gratuity-IN
Indemnity-BH
Indemnity-OM
Slab-Policy

fields.label: Settlement Basis
fields.options:
Basic Salary
Last Basic Salary
Average Total Salary

fields.label: Years Threshold
fields.description: Applies to tiered formulas

fields.label: Days/Year (Below Threshold)
fields.description: Legacy and no longer read. Gratuity comes from the Gratuity Slabs table.

fields.label: Days/Year (Above Threshold)
fields.description: Legacy and no longer read. Gratuity comes from the Gratuity Slabs table.

fields.label: Min. Service for Gratuity (Years)
fields.description: India: 5 years minimum

fields.label: Primary Permit Name
fields.description: E.g. Iqama, Emirates ID, CPR, Work Permit, ROP Card

fields.label: National ID Name
fields.description: E.g. Muqeem, Emirates ID, CPR, Aadhaar, Civil ID

fields.label: Recurring Work Permit Fees
fields.description: Recurring per-worker government fee for holding a work permit (Bahrain: the LMRA monthly fee). Leave the rate at 0 and the applicability blank until the client has confirmed the figure that applies to them — HR Suite reports the liability as "not configured" rather than assuming one.

fields.label: Fee Authority
fields.description: Body that levies the fee, e.g. LMRA in Bahrain. Label only.

fields.label: Monthly Fee per Worker
fields.description: Amount charged per worker per month, in this country's currency. 0 means no rate has been confirmed; it is NOT a statement that the fee is zero.

fields.label: Fee Applies To
fields.description: Who the fee is charged for. Blank means the client has not confirmed the scope, and no liability is calculated.

fields.label: Fee Notes
fields.description: Exemptions, tiers or reference to the client's own confirmation.

fields.label: Scheme Name
fields.description: E.g. Nitaqat (SA), Nafis/Emiratisation (AE), Tanasub (OM)

fields.label: Population Label
fields.options:
Saudi National
Emirati National
Bahraini National
Omani National
Qatari National
Kuwaiti National
Indian National

fields.label: Working Hours per Month
fields.description: Divides the monthly basic salary to give the hourly rate. GCC practice is 30 days x 8 hours = 240; India uses 26 days x 8 hours = 208.

fields.label: Weekday Rate (x)
fields.description: Multiplier on the hourly rate for overtime worked on an ordinary working day.

fields.label: Night Rate (x)
fields.description: Optional. Used when the shift falls inside the night window. Leave at 0 where the country has no separate night rate.

fields.label: Weekly Rest Day Rate (x)
fields.description: Used when the date is a weekly off on the employee's Holiday List.

fields.label: Public Holiday Rate (x)
fields.description: Used when the date is a public holiday on the employee's Holiday List.

fields.label: Overtime Notes
fields.description: Statutory reference behind these figures, for whoever maintains this record.

fields.label: Days per Month (Leave Salary)
fields.description: Divides the monthly salary to give one day of leave pay. Gulf practice is 30. Use 26 where only working days are paid.

fields.label: Leave Salary Covers
fields.options:
Basic Only
Basic + Housing
Full Package
fields.description: Which parts of the salary are paid in advance when an employee goes on leave.

fields.label: Recovery Salary Component
fields.description: The deduction that claws leave salary back on the payslip for the month it covers. Leave blank and HR Suite creates one named Leave Salary Recovery.

fields.label: Earning Salary Component
fields.description: The earning a Leave Salary Settlement books for the leave salary due, as an Additional Salary on the payslip of the leave month. Leave blank and HR Suite creates one named Leave Salary.

fields.label: Leave Accrues
fields.description: Monthly turns a 30-day annual entitlement into 2.5 days credited every month, instead of the whole year granted up front.

fields.label: Credited On
fields.options:
First Day
Last Day
Date of Joining
fields.description: Which day of the period the accrued days land.

fields.label: Rounded To
fields.description: Leave blank for no rounding.

fields.label: Carried Leave Expires After (Days)
fields.description: 0 means carried leave never expires. Bahrain allows a limit; enter the one your contracts use.

fields.label: Leave Salary Notes
fields.description: Which law or contract these figures come from.

fields.label: Annual Leave Policy
fields.description: Drives accrual, leave salary and the Employee master. Values are the legal defaults of this country; edit them to match company policy.

fields.label: Leave Can Be Taken After (Months)
fields.description: 0 = leave can be taken as it accrues.

fields.label: Carry Forward
fields.options:
Per Company Policy
Settle Or Carry Within Years
Up To Cap

fields.label: Leave Accrual Engine
fields.options:
HRMS Earned Leave
HR Suite Ledger
fields.description: HR Suite Ledger accrues annual leave monthly from the policy bands into the Leave Accrual Ledger (30-day month, proration, two balances) and tops up the HRMS allocation. Blank or HRMS Earned Leave keeps the stock HRMS accrual. Switch only after the opening balances are imported.

fields.label: Ledger Accrues From
fields.description: First month the ledger accrues. Defaults to the first of the month in which the engine is switched on.

fields.label: Part-Month Accrual
fields.description: Over 30 Days: days worked / 30 (joining 9 March = 23/30 x 2.5 = 1.92). Month Fraction: scaled to the calendar month (23/31 x 2.5 = 1.85). Blank = Over 30 Days.

fields.label: Minimum Earned Leave-Salary Days
fields.description: Optional second barrier: the earned leave-salary balance must also reach this. 0 = none, so every day earned since joining is paid once the minimum service is met.

fields.label: Minimum Service From Joining (Days)
fields.description: Days from the joining date that must be reached before any leave salary is paid.

fields.label: Pay Accrued Leave On Exit Below Minimum Service
fields.description: Ticked: an employee who leaves before the minimum service is still paid the leave days accrued unused, on a Final Settlement. Unticked: the minimum service applies on exit too.

fields.label: Annual Leave Before Minimum Service
fields.description: Allow: leave may be taken, no leave salary is paid until the minimum service is met. Block: the Leave Application is refused. Unpaid: leave may be taken but payroll deducts those days.

fields.label: Pay Worked Days In Settlement
fields.description: Ticked: the settlement pays the salary for the days worked this month and the employee is skipped at month-end payroll. Unticked: the settlement pays leave salary only and payroll pays the worked days.

fields.label: Eligible After (Months)
fields.description: 0 = from joining.

fields.label: Split Sick Leave Into Pay Tiers Automatically
fields.description: Ticked: a Sick Leave application is split across the pay tiers below from what the employee has already used in the leave year, and payroll deducts the unpaid share. Leave unticked where sick leave is already modelled as separate part-pay and unpaid Leave Types, or the pay would be reduced twice.

fields.label: Sick Leave Pay Window
fields.options:
Leave Period
Calendar Year
Rolling 12 Months
Service Year
fields.description: The span in which sick days count towards the pay tiers. Leave Period uses the company Leave Period, else the calendar year. Rolling 12 Months looks back 12 months from each sick leave. Service Year runs from the joining anniversary.

fields.label: Pay Tiers
fields.description: Applied in order as days are used within the leave year. The days must add up to Sick Days / Year.

fields.label: Cap (Months Of Wage)
fields.description: 0 = no cap. UAE 24, Kuwait 18.

fields.label: Deduct Unpaid Leave From Service
fields.description: Qualifying service = days from joining to exit, less unpaid leave and unpaid absence, divided by 365.

fields.label: Minimum Service For Gratuity (Years)
fields.description: No gratuity below this much qualifying service. UAE and Qatar: 1. 0 = no minimum. (The older Gratuity Eligibility Years field above is no longer read.)

fields.label: Forfeited On Disciplinary Dismissal
fields.description: Ticked: no gratuity when the exit type is Dismissal (KSA Art. 80).

fields.label: Employer Gratuity Applies To Service Before
fields.description: Bahrain: 1 March 2024. From that date end-of-service is funded by contributions, not paid by the employer.

fields.label: Resignation Factors
fields.description: Empty = full gratuity on resignation.

fields.label: Nationals' Pension Scheme
fields.description: Nationals are covered by this scheme: SIO, SPF, GPSSA, GRSIA, PIFSS.

fields.label: Nationals Are Also Entitled To Gratuity
